#include "third_party/blink/renderer/modules/webgl/webgl_fingerprint.h"

#include <array>
#include <string>

#include "base/command_line.h"
#include "base/containers/span.h"
#include "base/strings/string_number_conversions.h"
#include "base/strings/string_util.h"
#include "base/time/time.h"
#include "components/ungoogled/ungoogled_switches.h"
#include "components/ungoogled/webgl_config_data.h"
#include "third_party/blink/renderer/bindings/modules/v8/webgl_any.h"
#include "third_party/blink/renderer/platform/wtf/text/wtf_string.h"

namespace blink {

namespace {

using ungoogled::fingerprint::kMacOSWebGLConfigs;
using ungoogled::fingerprint::kWindowsWebGLConfigs;
using ungoogled::fingerprint::WebGLConfig;
using ungoogled::fingerprint::WebGLParamSet;

// Returns the active per-device config, or nullptr when WebGL spoofing is off
// for this process (no --fingerprint, disabled via --disable-spoofing=gpu, or a
// platform with no config data such as linux).
const WebGLConfig* GetActiveWebGLConfig() {
  const base::CommandLine* command_line =
      base::CommandLine::ForCurrentProcess();
  if (!command_line->HasSwitch(switches::kFingerprint)) {
    return nullptr;
  }
  if (command_line->HasSwitch(switches::kDisableSpoofing) &&
      command_line->GetSwitchValueASCII(switches::kDisableSpoofing)
              .find("gpu") != std::string::npos) {
    return nullptr;
  }

  std::string platform = "windows";
  if (command_line->HasSwitch(switches::kFingerprintPlatform)) {
    platform = base::ToLowerASCII(
        command_line->GetSwitchValueASCII(switches::kFingerprintPlatform));
  }

  base::span<const WebGLConfig> configs;
  if (platform == "windows") {
    configs = base::span(kWindowsWebGLConfigs);
  } else if (platform == "macos") {
    configs = base::span(kMacOSWebGLConfigs);
  } else {
    // linux / unknown platform: no config data, do not spoof.
    return nullptr;
  }

  uint64_t seed = 0;
  base::StringToUint64(
      command_line->GetSwitchValueASCII(switches::kFingerprint), &seed);
  return &configs[static_cast<size_t>(seed % configs.size())];
}

const WebGLParamSet& ActiveParamSet(const WebGLConfig& config, bool is_webgl2) {
  return is_webgl2 ? config.gl2 : config.gl1;
}

// WEBGL_debug_renderer_info enums (webgl_debug_renderer_info.h). These are
// extension-gated upstream and handled at their case sites, not at the top.
constexpr unsigned kUnmaskedVendorWebgl = 0x9245;
